newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish new car registrations up 25 pct June - group.
newsitem.headline: Swedish new car registrations up 25 pct June - group.

text.p: New car registrations in Sweden rose 25 percent to 20,884 in June compared to the same month one year earlier, the Association of Swedish Automobile Manufacturers and Wholesalers said on Tuesday.
The association said in a statement that to date this year 114,447 new cars have been registered in Sweden which is a 30 percent increase from a year ago when 88,193 were registered.
Sweden has two sources of car registrations.
Sweden's official statistics bureau, Statistics Sweden, is due to release its new car registrations figures at 0800 GMT on Tuesday.
